cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the finished budget report: one title page, with generous room for contributions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we have your figures? The board meets in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Participation is approved. This is the finished discussion edition; the board may supply its figures directly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you at least give the chair a recommendation? She doesn't want a discussion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A recommendation is authorized. I'll add 'Approve' under the title. The finished decision edition has now eliminated the need for discussion.

reason: Rereading found that naming the title page did not explicitly establish it was the whole report. State one title page so the reader does not need to infer the missing work from later requests alone.
